advanced-filter-description: U ṱalula ha nṱha hu tendela u ṅwala maipfi a re na ndaela idzi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Tshikhala tshi fhambanya ndaela. Ni nga ṱalula fhethu hoṱhe ha data ho dzudzanywaho nga u ṅwala madzina na ndeme. Sa tsumbo: Field1 == Value1. Ṱhogomelani: Arali fhethu kana ndeme zwi na zwikhala, zwi vheeni vhukati ha zwiga zwa khotheisheni nthihi. Sa tsumbo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. U pfuka zwiga zwa u langa (' \/), ni nga shumisa \. Sa tsumbo: Field1 == I\'m. Ni nga ṱanganya zwiimo zwinzhi. Sa tsumbo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Nga misi ndaela dzi ṱalutshedzwa u bva kha tsha monde u ya kha tsha u ḽa. Ni nga shandula mutevhe nga zwitangeli. Sa tsumbo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ni nga ṱoḓa fhethu ha maipfi nga regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Nambatedza Kanboard export JSON: tshithu tshi re na "columns" (kana mishumo i hwalaho column_name) na tshiṱaka "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns dzi vha mitevhe nahone mishumo i vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Nambatedza NextCloud Deck board JSON (bodo ḽi re na "stacks", stack iṅwe na iṅwe i hwala "cards" dzayo). Stacks dzi vha mitevhe nahone makhaḓi a vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Nambatedza OpenProject work-packages collection JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses dzi vha mitevhe nahone work packages dzi vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Nambatedza __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues dzi vha makhaḓi o dzudzanywaho kha mitevhe ya Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Nambatedza Asana tasks export JSON ({ "data": [...] } u bva kha Asana export kana GET /tasks). Mishumo yo dzudzanywa kha zwipiḓa (memberships); mishumo yo fhelaho i ya kha Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Nambatedza ZenKit list export JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages dzi vha mitevhe nahone items dzi vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namatedza mutevhe wa mishumo ya markdown (nzila ine zwishumiswa zwa markdown-kanban zwo nga Obsidian Kanban zwi shumisaho): thoho dza "## Dzina ḽa mutevhe", na zwithu zwa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" fhasi. Thoho dzi vha mitevhe nahone zwithu zwi vha makhadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Nambatedzani tshivhumbeo tsha Leo (faela ya .leo). Zwipiḓa zwa vhuimo ha nṱha zwi vha mitevhe, zwipiḓa zwi re fhasi hazwo thwii zwi vha garaṱa, nahone maṅwalwa a tshipiḓa a vha ṱhaluso ya garaṱa. Zwipiḓa zwa vhuimo ho dzikaho zwi vha mitevhe ya u ṱola. Zwipiḓa zwo swaiwaho zwi dzheniswa sa zwo fhedzwaho.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Nambatedzani faela ya todo.txt: mushumo muthihi kha mutaladzi muṅwe na muṅwe, sa zwine app ya todo.txt na app dzi tshimbilelanaho nayo zwa ṅwalisa zwone. Mishumo yo fhelaho ("x") i ya kha Yo fhela, +project na @context zwi vha dzilebulu, (A) i vha lebulu ya zwine zwa tea u thoma, ngeno due: na t: zwi tshi vha maḓuvha a u fhedza na a u thoma.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Nambatedzani mvelelo ya task export: mutevhe wa JSON, kana mushumo muthihi kha mutaladzi muṅwe na muṅwe. Mishumo yo fhelaho i ya kha Done, project na priority zwi shanduka zwa vha dziḽeibuḽu, annotations i shanduka ya vha mihumbulo, nahone depends i shanduka ya vha vhushaka ha u ḓitika nga mishumo ine ya khou thivhela uyu mushumo.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Vulani faela ya .boardarchive ni nambatedze board.jsonl ya bodo, i na mutaladzi wa nzudzanyo kana i si nawo. Tshivhumbeo tsha u kuvhanganya nga zwigwada kha mbonalo ya bodo tshi shanduka tsha vha mitevhe, zwiṅwe zwivhumbeo zwa u nanga zwi shanduka zwa vha dziḽeibuḽu, zwipiḓa zwa maṅwalwa na mabogisi a u maka zwi shanduka zwa vha ṱhaluso na mutevhe wa u ṱola, nahone mihumbulo a a vhulungwa. Zwifanyiso na zwiambataniswa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Kha Todoist, vulani phurodzheke, nangani menyu ya ⋯ i re nṱha kha tshauri, nga murahu Manage data > Export as CSV, ni nambatedze faela ya CSV. Zwipiḓa zwi vha mitevhe, mishumo i vha makhadi, mishumo miṱuku i vha mutevhe wa u sedza, zwiṱodzi zwi vha mihumbulo, nahone @labels na zwi ṱanganedzwaho u thoma p1 u swika p3 zwi vha dziḽeibuḽu.
import-board-instruction-planner: Kha Microsoft Planner, vulani pulane, nangani menyu ya ⋯ i re tsini na dzina ḽayo, nga murahu Export as Excel (kha Planner ya kale: Export plan to Excel), ni nange iyo faela ya .xlsx. Buckets dzi vha mitevhe nahone mishumo i vha makhadi, na vho avhelwaho mushumo, maḓuvha, dziḽeibuḽu, mutevhe wa u sedza na ṱhaluso zwazwo; Progress, Priority na Completed By zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: In MeisterTask, click the project name, choose Export project and export the CSV, then paste it. Sections become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, due date, assignee and tags; completed tasks keep their completion date. A CSV written for MeisterTask's own import works too.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: In Obsidian, open the Kanban board's file as Markdown (or open the .md file in a text editor), then paste all of it. Lanes become lists with their card limits, cards keep their tags, dates, priority, fields and checklist, and the Archive becomes archived cards.
import-board-instruction-linear: In Linear, export the issues as CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, or a view's export), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, teams become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their assignee, labels, dates, parent issue, priority, estimate, project and cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: In TickTick, open Settings, Account, Backup & Import and generate a backup, then paste the CSV file. Each TickTick list becomes a swimlane and its columns become lists; tasks keep their tags, dates, checklist, priority and subtasks.
import-board-instruction-clickup: In ClickUp, export the tasks as CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, or a List or Table view's export with all columns), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, ClickUp lists become swimlanes, and tasks become cards with their subtasks, assignees, tags, dates, priority and time.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: In Nullboard, open the board, choose Export this board... from the menu, open the .nbx file in a text editor and paste its contents. Lists become lists and notes become cards: a note's first line is the card title and the rest its description. A raw note gets the label raw. A file with several boards imports its first board.
import-board-instruction-kanri: In Kanri, open Import & Export and choose Export individual board (or Export all data), then paste the .json file. Columns become lists and cards become cards, with their description, due date, tags and colors; a card's tasks become a checklist. From an all-data export the first board is imported.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: In Pivotal Tracker, open the project's MORE tab and choose Export CSV (or select stories and choose Bulk Actions, CSV), then paste the CSV. Each story state becomes a list and stories become cards, with their type and labels, owners, requester, dates, comments, tasks and blockers; Estimate becomes Story points and iterations become sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: In Tasks.org, open Settings, Backups and choose Export tasks, then paste the contents of that .json file. Lists become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, tags, dates, comments and subtasks; completed tasks keep their completion date, and priority becomes a custom field.
import-board-instruction-monday: In monday.com, open the board menu, choose More actions and Export board to Excel (with updates and subitems if you like), then choose that .xlsx file. The Status column becomes lists and groups become swimlanes; people, dates, timeline and tags keep their places, other columns become custom fields and updates become comments.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: In Super Productivity, open Settings, then Sync & Backup, choose Export Data and paste the contents of the sp-backup .json file. Each project becomes a swimlane and tasks become cards in To Do, In Progress, Backlog or Done, with their notes, tags, due date, time spent and sub-tasks; archived tasks become archived cards.
import-board-instruction-taiga: In Taiga, open Admin > Project > Export and download the project dump (unpack a .json.gz file first), then paste its JSON. User story statuses become lists, user stories become cards with their tasks as subtasks, epics and issues get swimlanes of their own, and sprints, tags, comments and custom attributes come along. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: In Vikunja, open Settings, choose Data Export and download the .zip file it sends you, then choose that file, or paste the data.json inside it. Kanban buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their labels, assignees, dates, description, task lists as checklists and comments; priority, percent done and done become custom fields. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-quire: In Quire, open the project menu and choose Export CSV, then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists and tasks become cards, with their subtasks as child cards, assignees, tags as labels, start, due and completed dates, description and priority as a custom field. Comments and attachments are not in Quire's CSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: In Wrike, export a project or folder to Excel, or fill in Wrike's Excel import template, then choose that .xlsx file. Folder and project rows become swimlanes, Status becomes lists and tasks become cards, with their Key, parent task, assignees, start and end dates, dependencies and description; Priority, Duration and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: In Teamwork.com, fill in the Excel task import template (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) and save it as .xlsx, then choose that file. Task lists become lists and tasks become cards; a task starting with -, # or > becomes a subtask of the task above it (--, ## or >> one level deeper). Assignees, dates and tags keep their places; Priority, Estimated time and Complete become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: In Businessmap (formerly Kanbanize), open Advanced Search, choose Configure results to pick the columns, download the Excel file, then choose that .xlsx file. Columns are read by their English names (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): if your account uses another language, rename the header row to English first. Column becomes lists and Lane swimlanes; owners, tags, color, dates, comments and parent links keep their places, and Priority, Size, Type and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-redmine: In Redmine, open the project's Issues, choose Also available in: CSV at the bottom of the list, pick the columns (All columns, with Description) and export, then paste the CSV. Redmine names the columns in your language, so set your language to English in My account before exporting. Each status becomes a list and issues become cards, with the tracker as a label, assignee, author, dates, parent task and related issues; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done and custom fields become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-notion: In Notion, open the database as a full page, choose ••• and Export, pick Markdown & CSV, and choose the .zip file it downloads, or one database CSV from it, or paste that CSV. A column named Status becomes the lists (without one, the first column that looks like a select does, and the import report says which); rows become cards with their title, tags as labels, people as members, dates, and the page text as the description; other columns become custom fields. Relations, images and attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-plane: In Plane, open Workspace Settings, choose Exports, export the projects as JSON, CSV or Excel and download the .zip file, then choose that file, or one file from inside it, or paste the JSON or CSV. Export writes this board's lists as one, named after the board, in the JSON Wrike's API returns for workflows: create that workflow in Wrike before importing the board's Wrike Excel export, so its statuses are applied. Import reads that JSON pasted above, from WeKan or from Wrike's GET /workflows, into the chosen board: a status without a list becomes a list, and a rule marks a card complete when it is moved into a Completed or Cancelled status and incomplete in an Active or Deferred one. Wrike's own automation rules cannot be exported from Wrike.

U vhea `-` phanḓa ha *<field>* hu ṱoḓa u sa vha na ndeme kha fhethu honoho (sa `has:-due` i ṱoḓa makhadi a si na ḓuvha ḽa u fhedzwa).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - hune *<sort-name>* ya vha iṅwe ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kana `__predicate_modified__`. U dzudzanya u bva nṱha u ya fhasi, vheani `-` phanḓa ha dzina ḽa u dzudzanya.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - hune *<n>* ya vha nomboro yo fhelelaho i re nṱha ha zero i sumbedzaho tshivhalo tsha makhadi a u sumbedza kha siaṱari ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ndaela dzi fanaho dzi ṱanganywa nga *OR* (kana). Hu ḓo bviswa makhadi ane a tevhela tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha zwiimo.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` i bvisa makhadi kha mutevhe une dzina ḽawo ḽa vha *Blocked* kana *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Ndaela dzi sa fani dzi ṱanganywa nga *AND* (na). Hu bviswa fhedzi makhadi ane a tevhela zwiimo zwoṱhe. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` i bvisa fhedzi makhadi kha mutevhe *Available* a re na ḽeibuḽu *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Maḓuvha a nga ṅwalwa sa nomboro yo fhelelaho i re nṱha kana fhasi ha zero, kana nga `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kana `__predicate_year__` kha tshifhinga tsha zwino.

database-migration-description: Pfulusela data ya maṅwalwa (zwoṱhe nga nnḓa ha zwo namaṱheliswaho na avatar, zwine zwa sala kha filesystem) vhukati ha MongoDB na FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Iṅwe database i tea u vha i tshi khou shuma nahone i tshi swikelelwa (maphothi a mvelaphanḓa: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; shandula nga WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Nga murahu ha musi ho fhela, sedzisa MONGO_URL kha iṅwe database nahone thoma hafhu WeKan (kha Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb kana =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Pfulusela data ya maṅwalwa kha FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migrate-to-mongodb: Pfulusela data ya maṅwalwa kha MongoDB
database-migration-confirm: Kopa collections dzoṱhe dza maṅwalwa kha __db__? Zwo namaṱheliswaho na avatar kha filesystem a zwi kwamei. Database ya u swikela i tea u vha i tshi khou shuma.
database-migration-done: U pfulusela data ya maṅwalwa ho fhela.
sandstorm-migration-description: Musi WeKan i tshi shuma ngomu kha Sandstorm grain, database yayo ya kale ya MongoDB 3 i pfuluselwa kha FerretDB v1 (SQLite) kha u thoma u vulwa, nahone zwo namaṱheliswaho na avatar zwi pfuluselwa u bva kha database zwi ya kha thumba dza grain dza files/attachments na files/avatars. Hezwi zwi sumbedza arali u pfulusela ho bvelela nahone tshikhala tshingafhani tsha disiki tshine faela ya kale ya raw ya MongoDB database tshi tshi ḓi shumisa ngomu kha grain, nahone zwi ni tendela u thutha faela idzo dza raw u itela u vhofholola tshikhala.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb: Faela dza raw dza MongoDB 3 database
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Thutha faela dza raw dza MongoDB database
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Nga murahu ha u pfulusela ho bvelelaho data i dzula kha FerretDB na kha filesystem, ngauralo faela dza kale dza raw dza MongoDB 3 database dzi nga thuthiwa u itela u vhofholola tshikhala tsha disiki ya grain. Hezwi a zwi nga vhuyedzwi.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Thutha faela dza raw dza MongoDB 3 database u itela u vhofholola tshikhala tsha disiki? Data yo no pfuluselwa kha FerretDB na kha filesystem. Hezwi a zwi nga vhuyedzwi.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Faela dza raw dza MongoDB database dzo thuthiwa, ho vhofhololwa
features-desc: Zwiitwa zwa u ḓikhethela zwine WeKan ya zwi ṋea. Tshiitwa tshi songo khethwaho tshi a dzumbiwa kha vhashumisi vhoṱhe. Data yatsho i a vhulungwa nahone thendelo a dzi shanduki.
feature-views-table-desc: Bodo sa thebuḽu ya magaraṱa ane a nga tevhekanywa.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Khaḽenda na khaḽenda ya bodo nnzhi.
feature-views-overview-desc: Mbalombalo, u kuvhanganya nga muthu o ṋewaho mushumo, pulane ya mushumo, deshibodo na bodo khulwane.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Nḓila tharu dza u vhona tshati dza Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Mishumo ya tshibveledzwa yo salaho, zwifhinga zwipfufhi zwa u shuma, muvhigo wa tshifhinga tshenetsho na luvhilo lwa mushumo.
feature-views-flow-charts: Tshati dza u elela ha mishumo
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Mishumo yo salaho, mishumo yo fhelaho, u elela ho kuvhanganywaho, tshifhinga tsha u shuma na tsha u lindela, tshivhalo tsha mishumo yo fhelaho, tshifhinga tshe mishumo ya lindela, zwikhukhulisi, Monte Carlo na zwiṅwe zwipimo zwa u elela ha mishumo.
feature-views-map-desc: Magaraṱa sa zwiga kha tshifanyiso tsho dzheniswaho.
feature-approval-required: Itani uri zwiitwa zwo engedzwaho nga khwiniso dza WeKan zwi si shume u swika mulanguli a tshi zwi tendela
feature-preview-admins: Vhalanguli vha vhona zwiitwa zwo dzimiwaho uri vha zwi linge u thoma
feature-pilot-users: Vhashumisi vha u linga vhane vha dovha vha vhona zwiitwa zwo dzimiwaho
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Madzina a vhashumisi, o khethekanywaho nga khoma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Zwo vhulungwa. Madzina aya a vhashumisi ha ngo wanala:
card-field-visibility-desc: The fields of Board Settings / Card that boards can show. An unticked field is hidden from every card, minicard and Board Settings / Card of every board. No card data or board setting changes, and ticking it again shows each board as it was set. The order of the fields is each board's own.
cards-loading-auto: Zwi ḓi itaho (u laisa ho lengaho kha mabodo mahulu fhedzi)
cards-loading-description: Nḓila ine bodo ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa layisha makhaḓi aḽo. Makhaḓi oṱhe: khaḓi ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽi layishelwa kha buraweza (zwa u leluwa, zwiitwa zwoṱhe zwi a shuma, fhedzi bodo ḽi re na maḓana a makhaḓi ḽi rumela data nnzhi kha muvhoni muṅwe na muṅwe). Lazy: mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe u layisha fhedzi makhaḓi a vhonalaho zwino (infinite scroll) na muvhalo u tshilaho, ngauralo mabodo mahulwane vhukuma a shumisa memori na bandwidth i ṱhukhu. Zwi dovha zwa vhewa nga CARDS_LOADING environment variable.
cards-loading-lazy-note: U layisha makhaḓi nga lazy ndi zwa u lingwa: dzikhaunthara dza makhaḓi na WIP limits ndi dza vhukuma, fhedzi Calendar/Table/Gantt views na multi-select zwi sumbedza fhedzi makhaḓi o layishwaho u swika zwino. Layisha hafhu mabodo o vulwaho nga murahu ha u shandula hezwi.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Musi zwo vulwa, dzilinki dzoṱhe (zwivhili markdown links dzi ngaho [label](url) na raw HTML <a href> tags) dzi dzula dzi tshi sumbedzwa sa maṅwalwa fhedzi, a dzi puṱedzei kha tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshiṱaka tsha maṅwalwa (dzithero na ṱhalutshedzo dza bodo na khaḓi, mibono, tshekilisiti, na zwiṅwe). Hezwi zwi thivhela dzilinki dzi xedzaho dzi puṱedzeaho. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa, ngauralo dzilinki dzi dzula dzi tshi puṱedzea.
always-show-code-as-text: Sumbedza misi yoṱhe khoudu yoṱhe sa maṅwalwa fhedzi
always-show-code-as-text-description: Musi zwo vulwa, maṅwalwa a rich text a hongo sumbedzwa sa markdown kana HTML: tshiko tshoṱhe tshi dzula tshi tshi sumbedzwa sa maṅwalwa fhedzi kha tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshiṱaka tsha maṅwalwa (dzithero na ṱhalutshedzo dza bodo na khaḓi, mibono, tshekilisiti, na zwiṅwe). Hezwi zwi bvisela khagala zwidzhena zwo dzumbiwaho — HTML comments (<!-- -->), tshine markdown links tsha nanga, JavaScript na iṅwe khoudu iṅwe na iṅwe — ngauralo khoudu yoṱhe i dzula i tshi vhonala, a i puṱedzei, nahone a i shumi. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa, ngauralo markdown i sumbedzwa nga ho teaho.
disable-all-import-description: Musi zwo vulwa, zwiitwa zwoṱhe zwa u dzhenisa zwi a dzimiwa: u dzhenisa bodo u bva kha WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo, na u kopa bodo. Zwikhetho zwa menyu ya u dzhenisa zwi a dzumbiwa nahone seva i hana khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe ya u dzhenisa. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
disable-all-export-description: Musi zwo vulwa, zwiitwa zwoṱhe zwa u bvisela nnda zwi a dzimiwa: u bvisela nnda bodo sa WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kana kha NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, na u bvisela nnda tsho namaṱheliswaho tshithihi. Zwikhetho zwa menyu ya u bvisela nnda zwi a dzumbiwa nahone seva i hana khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe ya u bvisela nnda. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
disable-import-avatars-description: Musi zwo vulwa, avatar (zwifanyiso zwa phurofaela ya vhashumisi) a zwi dzheniswi. Hezwi zwi katela u dzhenisa WeKan JSON, u dzhenisa Trello, na u ṱanganyisa avatar u bva kha vhaṋei vha vhuḓivhi vha nnḓa kha u dzhena (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Madzina na iṅwe data zwi kha ḓi dzheniswa; ndi avatar fhedzi dzi fhiraho. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
disable-export-avatars-description: Musi zwo vulwa, avatar (zwifanyiso zwa phurofaela ya vhashumisi) a zwi katelwi musi u tshi bvisela nnda bodo (WeKan JSON na CSV export). Madzina a vhashumisi na iṅwe data zwi kha ḓi bviselwa nnda; ndi avatar fhedzi dzi siiwaho. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
anonymize-import-users: Dzumba madzina a vhashumisi vha u dzhenisa
anonymize-import-users-description: Musi zwo vulwa, u dzhenisa bodo ḽa WeKan JSON zwi imelela dzina ḽa mushumisi muṅwe na muṅwe o dzheniswaho, dzina ḽoṱhe na maletere a u thoma nga zwiimela zwa muvhalo (user1, user2, ...), zwi bvisa avatar yawe, nahone zwi ṅwala hafhu @username mentions (na masimu a requested-by / assigned-by) ngomu kha zwidzhena zwa khaḓi na mbono zwo dzheniswaho. A hu na vhuṋe ha mushumisi ha vhukuma u bva kha bodo ḽa tshiko ḽo vhulungwaho. Ipfi "user" ḽi tevhela luambo lwa muthu ane a khou dzhenisa. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
anonymize-export-users: Dzumba madzina a vhashumisi vha u bvisela nnda
anonymize-export-users-description: Musi zwo vulwa, u bvisela nnda bodo zwi imelela dzina ḽa mushumisi muṅwe na muṅwe o bviselwaho nnda, dzina ḽoṱhe na maletere a u thoma nga zwiimela zwa muvhalo (user1, user2, ...), zwi bvisa avatar yawe, nahone zwi ṅwala hafhu @username mentions (na masimu a requested-by / assigned-by) ngomu kha zwidzhena zwa khaḓi na mbono. Faela yo bviselwaho nnda a i na vhuṋe ha mushumisi ha vhukuma. Ipfi "user" ḽi tevhela luambo lwa muthu ane a khou bvisela nnda. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
anonymize-account: Dzumba madzina a vhashumisi vha u dzhenisa
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Musi zwo vulwa, u bvisela nnda bodo zwi imelela dzina ḽa mushumisi muṅwe na muṅwe o bviselwaho nnda, dzina ḽoṱhe na maletere a u thoma nga zwiimela zwa muvhalo (user1, user2, ...), zwi bvisa avatar yawe, nahone zwi ṅwala hafhu @username mentions (na masimu a requested-by / assigned-by) ngomu kha zwidzhena zwa khaḓi na mbono. Faela yo bviselwaho nnda a i na vhuṋe ha mushumisi ha vhukuma. Ipfi "user" ḽi tevhela luambo lwa muthu ane a khou bvisela nnda. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
disable-activities-description: Musi zwo vulwa, zwidzhena zwa u phakela mishumo a zwi ṅwaliwi nahone a zwi sumbedzwi naho ngafhi (bara ya bodo na thebe ya mishumo ya khaḓi). A hu na ḓivhazwakale ha uri ndi nnyi o itaho mini. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
disable-notifications-description: Musi zwo vulwa, WeKan a i rumeli zwidivhadzo zwa u ṱhogomela (kha app, email kana tshiṅwe tshumelo) kha mushumo muṅwe na muṅwe. Mishumo i kha ḓi ṅwaliwa (arali i songo dzimwa nga nṱha); ndi zwidivhadzo fhedzi zwine zwa dzimiwa. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
disable-watch-description: Musi zwo vulwa, tshiitwa tsha u lavhelesa tshi a dzimiwa — vhashumisi a vha koni u ṱumela kha mabodo, mitevhe kana makhaḓi u itela u ṱanganedza zwidivhadzo, nahone lingedzo ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa u shandula levele ya u lavhelesa ḽi a hanelwa. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
backup-description: Ita bakapu ya Zwo Namaṱheliswaho, Avatar na/kana Data (collections dzoṱhe dza maṅwalwa dzi si dzo namaṱheliswaho kana avatar). .zip i rumelwa nga u ṱavhanya kha vhuvhulungo ho nangiwaho — hu si na faela ya tshifhinganyana — sa backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, i re na YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars na /data. Vhuvhulungo ha cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) vhu shumisa credentials dzo dzudzanywaho kha dzithebe dzavho dza vhuvhulungo.
backup-scope-description: Seva yoṱhe, kana tshiimiswa tshithihi. Bakapu ya tshiimiswa i na dzibodo dzatsho na zwoṱhe zwi re khadzo, na zwiṱaṱisi zwa idzo bodo — fhedzi a hu na akhaunthu dza vhashumisi kana mavhonele a seva, ngauri zwenezwo zwi shumiswa nga zwiimiswa zwoṱhe. U vusulusa bakapu ya tshiimiswa zwi ṅwala fhedzi kha dzibodo dza tshenetsho tshiimiswa.
theme-override-all-tenants: Mavhonele a shumaho kha vhahiri vhoṱhe
continuous-backup: Bakapu i sa vhuyi ya ima
continuous-backup-description: I rumela tshanduko iṅwe na iṅwe ya databeisi, zwo namaṱheliswaho, avatar na rekhodo dza mishumo kha foḽuda nga mithethe i si gathi, uri hu kone u vhuyedzwa kha tshiimo tsha tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe. I shuma khathihi na bakapu yo vhetshelwaho tshifhinga, ine ya ita khophi dzo fhelelaho.
continuous-backup-enabled: Itani bakapu i sa vhuyi ya ima kha seva iyi
continuous-backup-target: Foḽuda ine ha ḓo vhulungwa khayo (nḓila yo fhelelaho, kha disiki iṅwe, vhuvhulungo ho kovhiwaho kha netiweke kana vhuvhulungo ha rclone ho ṱumanywaho)
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (nga tshifhinga tshenetsho, tshanduko iṅwe na iṅwe)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Masiaṱari a SQLite (masiaṱari o shandukaho kha tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (mbekanyamushumo ya u tou nanga ine na i dzhenisa)
continuous-backup-engine-none: A hu na nzhini ya databeisi ine ya nga shuma kha seva iyi
continuous-backup-base-every: Khophi ya mutheo ntswa nga murahu ha (awara)
continuous-backup-encrypt: Dzumbani bakapu nga khoudu ya tshiphiri (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Faela ya khii ya khoudu ya tshiphiri (nḓila yo fhelelaho nnḓa ha foḽuda ine ha ḓo vhulungwa khayo; zwiga zwa 64 zwa maitele a nomboro a mutheo wa 16 kana mubulo wa tshiphiri une wa vha na zwiga zwa 16 kana u fhira). Vhulungani khophi: arali faela iyi i siho, bakapu i nga si vhuyiselwe.
continuous-backup-upload-none: A hu na fhethu (kha foḽuda ine ha ḓo vhulungwa khayo fhedzi)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Foḽuda ngomu ha tshifaredzi tsha u vhulunga
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Faela ya mbekanyamushumo ya Litestream (nḓila yo fhelelaho)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faela ya databeisi ya SQLite (i fhaṱiwa tsini na bakapu, a i ṅwali na luthihi nṱha ha faela ine ya khou shumiswa)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Shumisani databeisi ya SQLite yo fhaṱululwaho musi sisiteme i tshi thoma hafhu nga tshifhinga tshi tevhelaho (databeisi ya kale yo dzhielwaho vhudzulo i ḓo vhulungwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Vhuyedzani murafho wo nangiwaho kha tshifhinga tsho nangiwaho? Bakapu i sa vhuyi ya ima i ḓo ima lwa tshifhinganyana musi u vhuyedza hu tshi khou bvela phanḓa.
continuous-backup-saved: Nzudzanyo dza bakapu i sa vhuyi ya ima dzo vhulungwa
backup-restore-select-first: Nanga bakapu u bva kha mutevhe u thoma.
backup-restore-confirm: Vhuyedza bakapu yo nangiwaho? Zwo namaṱheliswaho/avatar zwi ṅwalwa kha filesystem nahone data kha database u ya nga modo yo nangiwaho.
gcs-key-filename: Nḓila ya faela ya khie ya service account
gcs-key-filename-description: A zwi ṱhogei: nḓila ya faela ya khie ya JSON ya service account kha seva.
gcs-credentials-description: A zwi ṱhogei: nambatedza khie ya JSON ya service account. Sia hu si na tshithu u itela u shumisa faela ya khie kana credentials dza mvelaphanḓa.
gcs-permissions-note: Ṋea service account ya WeKan pfanelo ya u vhala/u ṅwala kha bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bucket yaṋu → Permissions → Grant access. Kha "New principals", nambatedza email ya service account — vhuci ha "client_email" u bva kha khie yaṋu ya JSON — nga zwenezwo khetha mushumo "Storage Object Admin" nahone Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Sia hu si na tshithu u itela u dzula na vhuci ha zwino.
azure-account-name-description: Dzina ḽa akhaunthu yaṋu ya Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: Blob container ya u vhulunga faela.
gcs-project-id-description: Project id yaṋu ya Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Dzina ḽa bucket ya Cloud Storage ya u vhulunga faela.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: sia hu si na tshithu (i shumisa endpoint ya vundu). S3-compatible: Endpoint URL u bva kha console yaṋu ya MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bucket yaṋu → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → dzina ḽa bucket yaṋu (kana Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → mushumisi waṋu → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → khetha use case 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Yo sumbedzwaho sa 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Tshikirini tshi fanaho na Access key ID; 'Secret access key' i sumbedzwa luthihi fhedzi musi khie i tshi sikwa — i kopolole nga tshenetsho tshifhinga (kana Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaunthu yaṋu → dzina ḽo sumbedzwaho nṱha (na fhasi ha Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaunthu yaṋu → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaunthu yaṋu → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaunthu yaṋu → Data storage → Containers → container yaṋu (kana + Container u sika iṅwe).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → project selector nṱha → ID ya project yaṋu (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).

XmR i sumbedza ndeme nthihi nthihi na phambano dzi tevhekanaho, na vhukati na mikano ya mvelo ya kushumele; hu ṱoḓea mishumo i si fhasi ha mivhili yo fhelaho nga nḓila yo teaho.

Nyanganyelo dzi siho na maḓuvha a songo teaho a a litshwa. Arali hu si na mathomo, hu shumiswa ḓuvha ḽa u sikwa; arali hu si na magumo, hu shumiswa u vhulungwa.

email-recovery-description: Muduba muthihi kha muṱanganedzi muṅwe na muṅwe. Ṱoḓani nga ID ya mushumisi. Zwi re kha milaedza na zwipiḓa zwa imeyili ya muṱanganedzi a zwi sumbedzwi. U imisa lwa tshifhinganyana hu fara milaedza i re hone na ine ya ḓo ḓa; u isa phanḓa hu lingedza u rumela milaedza ya mutevhe zwino. U khansela hu bvisa milaedza yo dzheniswaho kha mutevhe u swika tshifhingani tsha khumbelo. Arali u rumela hu tshi khou bvela phanḓa, lingedzani hafhu nga murahu ha tshifhinganyana. Mulaedza wo no thomaho u rumelwa a u koni u humiselwa murahu, nahone u rumela hu sa khwaṱhisedzwaho hu nga dovhololwa. U kundelwa ha tshoṱhe na milaedza yo swikaho kha tshivhalo tsha ndingedzo tsho vhewaho zwi dzula zwo vhulungwa u itela u ṱoliwa. U lingedza hafhu milaedza yo kundelwaho hu thoma mutevhe muswa wa ndingedzo nahone hu vhulunga u imiswa lwa tshifhinganyana hu re hone.

stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.

stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Could not load the List Sync operations. Refresh to try again.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: This operation is no longer pending.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: This operation has not been found stuck, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: This operation can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it was not discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: This list is syncing right now. Try again in a moment.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Zwo kundwa u fhedza nyito iyi. Vha vule siaṱari hafhu vha lingedze hafhu.
interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.
interrupted-import-missing: This import is no longer recorded.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: The board with this id was not created by this import, so it was not touched.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: Zwo kundwa u fhedza nyito iyi. Vha vule siaṱari hafhu vha lingedze hafhu.

optional-apis-desc: Dzi-API dza REST dzo fanaho na dzi-API dza zwiṅwe zwishumiswa zwa u tevhela, uri dziapp na zwikiripiti zwadzo zwi kone u shumisa WeKan iyi sa backend yadzo: zwine dza zwi vhulunga zwi vhulungwa kha WeKan, kha bodo dza WeKan. Iṅwe na iṅwe yo valwa u swika i tshi swayiwa fhano. A hu na na nthihi i re na pfanelo dzayo: mushumisi (client) u dzhena nga token ya WeKan API nahone a nga vhona na u shandukisa zwine muthu onoyo a nga zwi vhona na u zwi shandukisa kha WeKan fhedzi. Dzoṱhe dzi ṱoḓa uri WeKan REST API i vhe yo vulwa (WITH_API=true). Diresi i re fhasi ha iṅwe na iṅwe ndi ine mushumisi a i shumisa sa seva yawe.
optional-api-trello-desc: Dziapp na zwikiripiti zwo ṅwalelwaho REST API ya Trello (sa tsumbo Trellinator) zwi shuma na WeKan: bodo, mitevhe, garaṱa, dziḽeibuḽu, miraḓo, mahumbulwa na mitevhe ya u sedza. Token ya Trello ndi token ya WeKan API. U bvisa garaṱa zwi i vhulunga kha WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Vhashumisi vha REST API v2 ya Jira vha shuma na WeKan: thandela ndi bodo (khii yayo ndi khii ya bodo), thaidzo ndi garaṱa (DEV-7), tshiimo ndi mutevhe, nahone u pfukela zwi tshimbidza garaṱa. U ṱoḓa zwi ṱanganedza JQL i leluwaho: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text na ORDER BY. Dzhenani nga token ya WeKan API sa phasiwede. U bvisa thaidzo zwi i vhulunga.
optional-api-github-desc: Vhashumisi vha REST API ya GitHub ya thaidzo vha shuma na WeKan: vhuvhulungelo (repository) ndi bodo, thaidzo ndi garaṱa, na dziḽeibuḽu, zwiṱaraṱa (dziḽeibuḽu dzi re na ḓuvha ḽa u fhela), mahumbulwa, na zwo vulea kana zwo valwa sa kha Mbonalo ya bodo / Ndaulo ya Vesheni. Token ndi token ya WeKan API.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Vhashumisi vha REST API ya Gitea na Forgejo ya thaidzo vha shuma na WeKan, nga nḓila i fanaho na API i tshimbilelanaho na GitHub: vhuvhulungelo ndi bodo nahone thaidzo ndi garaṱa. Token ndi token ya WeKan API.
